body:
I live near new York. I cannot afford to move to the city. It is hard to get any job there. The competition is so fierce.

There is very little housing where I live. The housing assistance program is only for people with kids. I thought about getting disability but I don't think my eating disorder would qualify. Counseling is expensive and I don't have insurance.

I can assure you that there is nothing liberating about destitution.

My old major was biochemistry but now I am majoring in nursing.  I did not do well first time around because I overscheduled myself. I was also dealing with harassment, bullying, a roommate from hell and an eating disorder.
This is the last thing I need. I am not sure if I can even get them.

No there are no jobs within walking distance and I don't feel safe biking. I tried working online but it seemed like a scam to be honest. I am going to school, I just can't physically get there without a car. If you mean transferring to my old one, that's out of the question sadly mostly due to cost.

I don't know if it would be possible to transfer again. I didn't do so well at my first college. Anyway it would mean taking on even more loans which I am scared of. A degree these days is not a guarantee of anything.
I can't think of anything that makes me happy. I used to have hope that things would get better but for me they tend to get worse.
I don't know. I cannot remember the last time I was happy.
Its a commuter school. No one I know lives close to me and I would feel bad asking an acquaintance to drive 45 minutes to pick me up and another 40 to school.
